title: AI Cover Letter Generator
subtitle: Paste the job description and your background. Get a tailored cover letter in seconds.
resultDisclaimer: Review carefully before sending. Add specific details only you can provide — the AI cannot invent real achievements.
whatIsText: Most cover letters are either generic templates or rewritten resumes. This tool reads the job description, matches it against your background, and writes a letter that connects the two. It highlights where your experience directly fits the role and speaks to what the employer is actually looking for — not just a list of past jobs.
tip1: Paste the full job description. The more detail you give, the more targeted the letter. If the job posting lists "requirements" and "responsibilities," include both.
tip2: Be specific in your background. "Managed marketing" produces generic output. "Ran paid acquisition for a DTC skincare brand, grew ROAS from 1.8 to 3.2 over 6 months" produces targeted output.
tip3: Choose achievement style for competitive roles. For senior positions or industries like consulting, finance, or tech, the achievement-focused style leads with numbers and outcomes.
tip4: Use career change style if switching fields. It reframes past experience as relevant rather than treating it as a gap.
faq1a: Yes. It runs on Cloudflare Workers AI with a free daily quota. Normal use won't hit limits.
faq2q: Will this get me flagged by employers?
faq2a: Not if you treat it as a draft. The tool produces a starting point. Good candidates edit the output to add specific details, correct anything inaccurate, and make it sound like them. Submitting raw AI output is obvious and hurts your application.
faq3a: No. Your job description and background are sent to the AI model for processing and discarded immediately after. Nothing is stored, logged, or used for training.
faq4a: No. The prompt explicitly tells the model not to invent numbers, employers, or achievements that aren't in your background. However, you should still review every sentence — the model can occasionally rephrase things in ways that overstate your experience.
faq5q: What is the ideal cover letter length?
faq5a: One page, or roughly 300-400 words. Recruiters spend 6-8 seconds on a first scan. Medium length is the safest default. Use Short for high-volume applications where the role is a strong match; use Long only when the job posting asks for a detailed letter.
disclaimer: Disclaimer: This tool generates draft cover letters. Always review and personalize before submitting. Never submit a cover letter you haven't read in full.
